name: Financial Institution Data 1
definition: Information related to a financial institution required by business or regulation (for example, in money or funds transfer).

BusinessIdentification.name: Business Identification
BusinessIdentification.definition: Business or client identification for financial institution.

BusinessName.name: Business Name
BusinessName.definition: Business name of the financial institution.

LegalCorporateName.name: Legal Corporate Name
LegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the financial institution.

AccountNumber.name: Account Number
AccountNumber.definition: Account number from which the funds get debited or credited.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of data in the current component.
